description:
Create a HITL (Human-in-the-Loop) config. Defines which messaging channels receive approval requests and the default timeout.

Agent usage: After creating a HITL config, you must call request_hitl_authorization before it can be used with create_confirmation. For Telegram channels, use create_chat_id_discovery first to discover the user's chat ID, then include it in the channel config.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.

channels.description: Messaging channels for approval requests (telegram or whatsapp). Either channels or circle_id is required.

circle_id.description: Route approvals through this circle's members instead of listed channels (24 hex characters)

name.description: Human-readable name for this HITL config

profile_id.description: The sub-account (24 hex characters) whose branding the approval messages carry; omitted, the primary

name: create_hitl

outputSchema.description: HITL configuration with messaging channels and timeout

circle_id.description: Backing Circle for a circle-backed Approvals config (null for channel-list configs)

keypair.description: Encryption keypair metadata (null if not configured)

user_id.description: Owner user ID (useful for SDK encryption AAD)
